title: dregea volubilis var. viridiflora
intro: Dregea volubilis var. viridiflora, commonly known as the Green Dragon Plant, is a perennial climber in the Apocynaceae family, native to tropical Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dregea volubilis var. viridiflora are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. Research has identified compounds like genistein, quercetin, and kaempferol as potential contributors to the plant's therapeutic effects.
